source.name: Spicer Designs Roofing website template
source.rightsEvidence: The downloaded HTML template is released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Its retained README states the hero artwork is AI-generated placeholder art. The full license is stored beside this manifest.

provenance.capture: Local render of the official HTML template at 1440x1000 and 390x844; no layout, source copy, or source artwork was changed.
provenance.attribution: Spicer Designs, CC BY 4.0. Source attribution remains in the captured page footer and is recorded here.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: Near-black storm-response page with a narrow orange alert strip, a wide roof-scene hero, a large left-aligned inspection promise, compact call/request actions, an early proof ribbon, a ground-level damage self-check, before/after comparison, homeowner-versus-contractor timeline, material selector, warranties, FAQs, and a detailed inspection form. The hero image is AI-generated placeholder art, not a customer property.

heroGeometry.mode: dark roof-scene with oversized left-aligned storm inspection promise
heroGeometry.alignment: copy left over an image and gradient with roof illustration on the right
heroGeometry.viewport: complete alert strip, navigation, promise and first request action fit the 1536x864 opening

navigationGeometry.placement: below a full-width orange storm-alert strip
navigationGeometry.mobile: brand plus one phone action, navigation collapsed into a short row

typography.display: heavy condensed grotesk with uppercase labels
typography.scale: large three-to-five-line poster headline, very small technical labels, readable body copy

palette.contrastIntent: high contrast; reserve orange for urgency, focus and next actions

imageTreatment.mode: cinematic roofline illustration with a darkened photograph-like texture
imageTreatment.crop: wide cover crop with fade into a solid text-safe region
imageTreatment.focalPoint: roof edge and warm light on the right; headline stays over quiet dark space

servicePresentation.pattern: ground-level damage checklist followed by direct repair and replacement choices
servicePresentation.interaction: checklist state plus a keyboard-accessible before/after control

ctaPlacement.primary: inspection request inside the first hero viewport
ctaPlacement.early: after the alert band and before the damage checklist

motion.primitive: severity response on selected visible symptoms and a draggable comparison handle
motion.reducedMotion: static comparison with all form and service choices visible

rules: show promise and request action before stats
stack diagnostic choices without horizontal scrolling
make comparison handle keyboard and touch accessible
keep the first FAQ and contact path easy to reach

prohibitedPatterns: copied source headline or sample claims
emergency availability claim unsupported by client facts

requiredSignatureElements.description: narrow high-visibility alert band above the utility navigation
ground-level symptom checklist that makes a roof concern legible
before/after work comparison with an accessible control
step timeline separating visitor actions from provider actions

acceptanceChecks: hero communicates the service and next action immediately
urgent and planned work are both easy to distinguish
all numeric claims come only from sealed verified tokens
desktop hero fits at 100 percent zoom
mobile has no horizontal overflow or inaccessible drag-only controls

review.scope: source license, asset provenance, full-page paired captures, and transferable design mechanics
